title: Muryar Hikima
intro: Muryar hikima mai taushi da aka taɓa rabawa wadda ta wuce lokaci. Wannan mutum, mai albarka da fahimta mai zurfi, ya ba da darussa masu mahimmanci waɗanda suka kasance abin haskakawa ga duk waɗanda ke neman jagora. Za ku iya gano asalin waɗannan kalmomi masu ɗorewa?
clues: An ba ni babbar ni'ima daga Allah, baiwar da ta haskaka zuciyata da tunanina.
Na juya ga ƙaunataccen ɗana, ina son in raba mafi taska da na mallaka.
Na yi gargaɗin cewa mafi girman rashin adalci shine a yi tarayya da Allah ɗaya tilo na gaskiya.
Na tunatar da cewa ko da nauyin ƙwayar mustard, wanda aka ɓoye a cikin dutse ko kuma a bayan sama, Allah zai yi masa hisabi.
Na umarce ni da in yi biyayya ga iyaye, kodayake biyayya tana cikin al'amuran adalci ne kawai.
Na koyar da kyawawan halaye: tafiya da tawali'u a ƙasa kuma ka daidaita muryarka; gama mafi tsananin sauti shine hayaniyar jakuna.

trial.label: Gwaji / Taro
options: Yana ba wa ɗansa shawara mai zurfi
Gina jirgi don tsira daga babban ambaliyar ruwa
Jure rashin lafiya mai tsanani da haƙuri
Karɓar allunan allahntaka a kan dutse
trial.answer: Yana ba wa ɗansa shawara mai zurfi

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: Shawararsa ta kasance marar mutuwa a cikin littafi mai tsarki na Allah
An ba shi annabci da sabuwar doka
Ya zama babban mai mulki a kan wata babbar masarauta
An tashe shi zuwa sama ba tare da mutuwa ba
Ya sami wahayi kai tsaye daga mala'ika
outcome.answer: Shawararsa ta kasance marar mutuwa a cikin littafi mai tsarki na Allah

arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا لُقْمَـٰنَ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ أَنِ ٱشْكُرْ لِلَّهِ ۚ وَمَن يَشْكُرْ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ حَمِيدٌۭ
verse: And We had certainly given Luqmān wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allāh." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allāh is Free of need and Praiseworthy. (31:12)
